attorneys: William G. Line for appellant, and Melvin Kent Kam-merlohr, Assistant Attorney General of Nebraska, for appellee on the joint motion.

opinions.text: Appeal from Sup. Ct. Neb. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 393 U. S. 1076.] Motion of appellant for leave to proceed further herein in forma pauperis granted. Motion for appointment of counsel granted. It is ordered that William G. Line, Esquire, of Fremont, Nebraska, a member of the Bar of this Court, be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for appellant in this case. Joint motion to dispense with printing appendix denied.
